caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object consisting of three main parts: a circular, shallow dish at the base, a cylindrical vertical support rising from the center of the dish, and a rectangular box with a hinged lid mounted on top of the support. The dish appears wide and slightly deep, providing a stable base. The vertical support is centrally positioned and is topped with a rectangular box that features some linear detailing on its sides and a clasp or latch on the top. A curved, flat handle or bracket extends outward from the central support just beneath the rectangular box, then curves back and attaches to the side of the box. The drawing is rendered in grayscale, with a focus on shading and texture to indicate the metallic material and form of the object. The background is plain, off-white, and there are no additional objects or decorations present.
title: Betty Lamp and Stand
